svg.title: Proposed tables around today's ledger
svg.desc: Entity-relationship diagram of five proposed tables (recurring series, goals, goal allocations, category plans and tags) around the existing accounts, categories and transactions ledger, with the new columns each existing table would gain.
svg.text: Every table also carries user_id, created_at, updated_at and deleted_at (soft delete). Money is signed integer minor units with a currency code.
